info.name: Task Manager assessment — local Docker
info.description: Run folders in order against the task-manager-manual Docker stack. The first request creates fresh demo emails and a local demo password. IDs and access tokens are saved as collection variables. The OpenAPI request checks the default hidden-docs state or parameter parity when docs are enabled. Migration and concurrency gates require the terminal commands in docs/MANUAL_TESTING.md.

exec: pm.test('Complete login token available', function () { throw new Error('Missing or truncated token. Run Login ' + roleMatch[1] + ' in this collection, then send this request again. Run the setup folder first if accounts are not registered.'); });

item.name: 00 Setup — accounts and login
item.description: Run first. Health generates fresh demo credentials for every collection run; later requests save IDs and tokens automatically.

exec: pm.test('public profile', function () { var profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); pm.expect(profile.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('owner_email')); });

pm.test('public profile', function () { var profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); pm.expect(profile.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('member_email')); });

pm.test('public profile', function () { var profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); pm.expect(profile.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('outsider_email')); });

pm.test('Full owner token saved automatically', function () { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('owner_token')).to.eql(savedResponse.access_token); pm.expect(savedResponse.access_token).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/); });

pm.test('30-minute Bearer token', function () { var login = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(login.token_type).to.eql('bearer'); pm.expect(login.expires_in).to.eql(1800); pm.expect(login.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('Full member token saved automatically', function () { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('member_token')).to.eql(savedResponse.access_token); pm.expect(savedResponse.access_token).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/); });

pm.test('30-minute Bearer token', function () { var login = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(login.token_type).to.eql('bearer'); pm.expect(login.expires_in).to.eql(1800); pm.expect(login.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('Full outsider token saved automatically', function () { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('outsider_token')).to.eql(savedResponse.access_token); pm.expect(savedResponse.access_token).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/); });

pm.test('30-minute Bearer token', function () { var login = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(login.token_type).to.eql('bearer'); pm.expect(login.expires_in).to.eql(1800); pm.expect(login.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('owner profile excludes hash', function () { var profile = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(profile.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('owner_id')); pm.expect(profile).to.not.have.property('password_hash'); });
pm.test('Authentication header indicates bearer scheme', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

item.name: 01 Core — create and retrieve lists
item.description: To verify persistence across API restart, run this folder, execute docker compose -p task-manager-manual restart api, then resend Retrieve main list.

exec: pm.test('normalized owned list and Location', function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.name).to.eql('Release work'); pm.expect(list.description).to.eql('Manual assessment'); pm.expect(list.owner_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('owner_id')); pm.expect(list.created_at).to.eql(list.updated_at); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include(list.id); });

pm.test('same list without embedded tasks', function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('main_list_id')); pm.expect(list).to.not.have.property('tasks'); });

item.name: 02 Core — list collection and updates
item.description: Lists are paginated. PATCH changes only supplied fields; a no-op keeps updated_at. Final list deletion is in folder 09.

exec: pm.test('list page', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.limit).to.eql(1); pm.expect(page.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(page.total).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(page.items.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('description cleared', function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.name).to.eql('Release work revised'); pm.expect(list.description).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Same-value list PATCH is a no-op
03 Core — task CRUD and status
item.description: Creates a default task, updates text/status, checks wrong parent, then deletes it. The second list stays empty for summary tests.

exec: pm.test('defaults and Location', function () { var task = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql('Draft notes'); pm.expect(task.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(task.priority).to.eql('medium'); pm.expect(task.description).to.eql(null); pm.expect(task.assignee_id).to.eql(null); pm.expect(task.created_at).to.eql(task.updated_at); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include(task.id); });
pm.test('trimmed task text', function () { var task = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql('Draft release notes'); pm.expect(task.description).to.eql('First draft'); });

item.name: 04 Core — filters, pagination and completion
item.description: Creates two completed/high, one pending/high and one in-progress/low task. Filters and pagination never change the whole-list summary.

exec: pm.test('empty summary', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(page.matched_tasks).to.eql(0); pm.expect(page.summary.total_tasks).to.eql(0); pm.expect(page.summary.completion_percentage).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('four tasks, two completed', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.matched_tasks).to.eql(4); pm.expect(page.summary.total_tasks).to.eql(4); pm.expect(page.summary.completed_tasks).to.eql(2); pm.expect(page.summary.completion_percentage).to.eql(50); });

pm.test('one match, whole-list summary', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(page.matched_tasks).to.eql(1); pm.expect(page.summary.total_tasks).to.eql(4); pm.expect(page.summary.completed_tasks).to.eql(2); pm.expect(page.summary.completion_percentage).to.eql(50); });

pm.test('empty page, accurate summary', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(page.matched_tasks).to.eql(3); pm.expect(page.summary.completion_percentage).to.eql(50); });
pm.test('list count, empty page', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(page.total).to.eql(2); });

pm.test('task count, empty page', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(page.matched_tasks).to.eql(4); pm.expect(page.summary.completion_percentage).to.eql(50); });

item.name: 05 Secure — carried defect regressions
item.description: Checks NUL text, field-level 422 errors, unknown/repeated query rejection and generated OpenAPI. Huge offsets were checked in folder 04.

exec: pm.test('field body.name', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.name'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('field body.title', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.title'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('field body.title', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.title'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('field body.name', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.name'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('field body.title', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.title'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('field body.owner_id', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.owner_id'; })).to.eql(true); });

request.description: With docs disabled, expect 404. Set ENABLE_API_DOCS=true and recreate the API to check parameter parity on a 200 response.

exec: pm.test('docs are hidden or enabled explicitly', function () { pm.expect([200,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('collection query parameters', function () { var paths = pm.response.json().paths; var listNames = paths['/api/v1/task-lists'].get.parameters.map(function (parameter) { return parameter.name; }); var taskNames = paths['/api/v1/task-lists/{list_id}/tasks'].get.parameters.map(function (parameter) { return parameter.name; }); pm.expect(listNames).to.include.members(['limit','offset']); pm.expect(taskNames).to.include.members(['limit','offset','status','priority']); }); }

item.name: 06 Secure — authorization and visible resources
item.description: Owner/member/outsider visibility and authentication-before-validation. Member has not yet accepted an invitation.

exec: pm.test('Authentication header indicates bearer scheme', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });
pm.test('visible resources only', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(page.items).to.eql([]); });

item.name: 07 Secure — invitations and assignments
item.description: Owner invites Member; wrong recipient cannot accept; Member joins and becomes eligible. Assignment create/PATCH, no-op, replace, clear and invalid targets are checked.

exec: pm.test('simulated one-time invitation', function () { var invitation = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(invitation.simulation.status).to.eql('simulated'); pm.expect(invitation.acceptance_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(invitation.recipient_email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('member_email')); });

pm.test('no token or verifier', function () { var invitation = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(invitation).to.not.have.property('acceptance_token'); pm.expect(invitation).to.not.have.property('token_hash'); });

pm.test('membership committed', function () { var membership = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(membership.list_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('main_list_id')); pm.expect(membership.user_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('member_id')); });

pm.test('two eligible participants', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(page.items.map(function (item) { return item.id; })).to.include.members([pm.collectionVariables.get('owner_id'),pm.collectionVariables.get('member_id')]); });

pm.test('five tasks, two completed', function () { var summary = pm.response.json().summary; pm.expect(summary.total_tasks).to.eql(5); pm.expect(summary.completed_tasks).to.eql(2); pm.collectionVariables.set('summary_before_assignment',summary.completion_percentage); });

pm.test('member assigned, status unchanged', function () { var task = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(task.assignee_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('member_id')); pm.expect(task.status).to.eql('pending'); });
pm.test('field body.assignee_id', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.assignee_id'; })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('field body.assignee_id', function () { var details = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(details.some(function (detail) { return detail.field === 'body.assignee_id'; })).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 08 Secure — removal and invitation lifecycle
item.description: Owner removal clears assignments. Accepted tokens cannot restore removed access. Resend rotates credentials; revoke is idempotent and terminal.

exec: pm.test('no token on later read', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property('acceptance_token'); });

item.name: 09 Cleanup — cascade and final visibility
item.description: Deletes only the two lists created by this collection. Demo accounts remain in the isolated manual database volume.

exec: pm.test('collection-created lists removed', function () { var page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(page.items).to.eql([]); });
